// 仅用于验收的进程驱动：正式 bootstrap / service / Mod 原样运行。
// 私有文件控制只调用公开的 Remote 所有权与 Nest Sender，不注册任何生产 HTTP/RPC 旁路。
package main

import (
	"ACTIVITY_MODULE/game/activity"
	syncsender "ACTIVITY_MODULE/game/handler/syncsender"
	"ACTIVITY_MODULE/internal/bootstrap"
	rpcworld "ACTIVITY_MODULE/internal/rpc/activity_world"
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"github.com/spf13/viper"
	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/framework/app"
	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/framework/entity"
	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/framework/nest"
	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/wiring/mods"
	"log/slog"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"strconv"
	"time"
	_ "time/tzdata"
)

func main() {
	activity.Register("operations-pending", activity.Hooks{
		Eligible: func(owner entity.IThreadSafeEntity, event string) bool {
			_, ok := owner.(activity.Owner)
			return ok && event == "operations"
		},
		Enter: func(c activity.Context) (bool, error) {
			return c.Snapshot.Token.Scope != "player" && (c.Snapshot.Token.Phase == activity.Initializing || c.Snapshot.Token.Phase == activity.Settling), nil
		},
	})
	a, err := bootstrap.New()
	if err == nil {
		a.Mods(&probe{})
		err = a.Execute()
	}
	if err != nil {
		slog.Error("activity acceptance exit", "err", err)
		os.Exit(1)
	}
}

type probe struct {
	registry *app.Registry
	cancel   context.CancelFunc
	done     chan struct{}
}

func (*probe) Name() app.ModName               { return "operations.probe" }
func (*probe) DependsOn() []app.ModName        { return nil }
func (*probe) Init(*viper.Viper) error         { return nil }
func (p *probe) Provide(r *app.Registry) error { p.registry = r; return nil }
func (p *probe) Start() error {
	dir := os.Getenv("OPERATIONS_CONTROL_DIR")
	if dir == "" {
		return fmt.Errorf("private control directory required")
	}
	var identity app.ServiceIdentity
	if err := app.LoadConfig(p.registry.Config(), &identity); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
	p.cancel = cancel
	p.done = make(chan struct{})
	go func() {
		defer close(p.done)
		p.run(ctx, filepath.Join(dir, identity.ServerType+"-"+strconv.Itoa(int(identity.Sid))))
	}()
	return nil
}
func (p *probe) Stop() {
	if p.cancel != nil {
		p.cancel()
		<-p.done
	}
}

func (p *probe) run(ctx context.Context, path string) {
	for {
		raw, err := os.ReadFile(path + ".request")
		if err == nil {
			var command struct {
				Op string
				ID int64
				To int32
			}
			err = json.Unmarshal(raw, &command)
			var result any
			if err == nil {
				callCtx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(ctx, 15*time.Second)
				switch command.Op {
				case "transfer":
					manager, ok := app.Lookup[entity.IRemoteEntityManager](p.registry, mods.ModRemoteEntity)
					if !ok {
						err = fmt.Errorf("Remote manager missing")
					} else {
						result, err = manager.TransferRemoteOwnership(callCtx, command.ID, command.To)
					}
				case "world-local-pulse":
					service, ok := app.Lookup[rpcworld.WorldActivities](p.registry, rpcworld.CapabilityName)
					if !ok {
						err = fmt.Errorf("World authority missing")
					} else {
						result, err = service.Pulse(callCtx, command.ID, "", 0)
					}
				case "player-event":
					client, ok := app.Lookup[nest.Client](p.registry, mods.ModNest)
					if !ok {
						err = fmt.Errorf("Nest missing")
					} else {
						result, err = syncsender.NewActivityEventSender(client).Sync_ActivityEvent(callCtx, command.ID, "operations", 0)
					}
				default:
					err = fmt.Errorf("unknown probe operation")
				}
				cancel()
			}
			answer := map[string]any{"result": result, "pid": os.Getpid(), "error": ""}
			if err != nil {
				answer["error"] = err.Error()
			}
			raw, _ = json.Marshal(answer)
			if err = os.Remove(path + ".request"); err != nil {
				panic(err)
			}
			if err = os.WriteFile(path+".response.tmp", raw, 0600); err != nil {
				panic(err)
			}
			if err = os.Rename(path+".response.tmp", path+".response"); err != nil {
				panic(err)
			}
		}
		select {
		case <-ctx.Done():
			return
		case <-time.After(20 * time.Millisecond):
		}
	}
}
